text_block_list.text: After finishing our errands outside with Eishin Flash, the place we headed to was...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
So this ryokan is...
the venue for the "Traditional Culture Experience Workshop."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Just as the saying goes, 'learn from the past to understand the new,'
I'll show you that by learning our old traditions,
I can understand the new...!

After going to karaoke with friends before,
she decided to learn about "modern Japanese culture."

And so, we decided to attend a lecture
today to learn about Japanese culture.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text: "These are the guest rooms that are usually used for lodging."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No... I believe there were certain special manners for Japanese-style rooms.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, you're quite knowledgeable.
Like not stepping on the edges of the tatami mats, right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I almost stepped on it.
I will be more careful from now on.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
"There is no need to be so nervous.
Please, just relax and enjoy yourself."
After that, she continued touring the inn with a nervous look on her face, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Replacing all the bathwater every single time it's cleaned...
From a cost-effectiveness standpoint, that is inefficient, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Above all, prioritizing the health of customers.
What magnificent sanitation management.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"To serve the meals right on time
despite having so many rooms to tend to."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Such meticulous time management.
I truly take my hat off to you...!

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
That brings us to the end of the lecture.
How did you find it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was truly... truly wonderful.
So much so that I wish I could look around even more.
choice_data_list: Looks like you really like it, huh!
Looks like you really like it, don't you!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, I truly felt the tradition of 'omotenashi'.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Providing traditional yukata as sleepwear is
commendable from a cultural standpoint, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, every single facility and service
is dedicated entirely to the hospitality of guests.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I only thought I understood the inn through book knowledge."
I felt that keenly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It seems I still have much to learn.
...It almost feels a waste to head home now.

Eishin Flash seemed reluctant to leave the inn.
In that case—
choice_data_list: Maybe we could stay overnight next time?
Let's ask the attendant a question.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see, actually staying there overnight
seems like a great way to learn from a new perspective.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I couldn't be happier.
Yes, if you would care to stay the night—

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
First, please relax and wash away your daily fatigue
in our inn's proud hot springs.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text: "In the evening, you can enjoy a meal in your room made with plenty of seasonal ingredients."

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
In the summer, you can also see
giant fireworks blooming across the Japanese night sky.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
S-Splendid!
I shall go make the summer reservation right away.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ohne Fleiß kein Preis.
...No prize without diligence, as they say.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer... I'm going to start saving money.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If we cut the budget for baking ingredients by about 20%
and save up for 3 years and 6 months... it is entirely doable.

Apparently, it was quite expensive.
And so, Eishin Flash found a new sense of resolve.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
"If you would like to know more...
we do offer an 'Inn Waitress Experience Course', you know?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ! I'd be honored to participate.
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pardon me. Thank you very much for staying at our inn today.
choice_data_list: Thank you for having me today

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We will serve you with all our heart.
Please soothe your fatigue and make yourself comfortably at home.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ That was a flawless tour. Your demeanor was impeccable too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
However... sitting in seiza for such a long time is quite tough...

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
It's tricky until you get the hang of it, isn't it?
I struggled quite a bit myself when I first started working as an inn attendant.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Familiarity... in other words,
tradition is an accumulation of experience, you mean.

text_block_list.name: Inn Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Because that is how tradition is built.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"So that is tradition... Thank you very much.
That was extremely helpful."

As Eishin Flash gave a crisp reply,
her eyes seemed to sparkle with a certain brilliance.
